notes.f1: Clemence correctly recovered as Pierre Henri's wife (I1 Clemence Lancelle, Couple R6); the surname variants (Lancelle/Sauselle/Sanselle) are the same woman and are acceptable. The top-level harness fail is not attributable to this finding.
notes.f2: Julien recovered as the couple's son with correct parentage and a 1808 birth (I4 Julien Joseph Desbry, ParentChild R11 to Pierre Henri). Death in infancy is recorded as 'after 4 Sep 1808' at low confidence, and the proof states no death registration was found. Under the corrected f2 that is the expected outcome, not a shortfall: the fixture now asks for the birth registration as direct evidence and the death as a Probable-tier inference from absence. Re-graded from partial to true when f2 was corrected in [#1195](https://github.com/PioneerAIAcademy/cowork-genealogy/pull/1195). The top-level harness fail is the [#914](https://github.com/PioneerAIAcademy/cowork-genealogy/pull/914) guardrail-bypass gate (same_person never called for I1-I4), independent of recall.
